macro.description: Bilingual authored explanation for the logic library.

en.body: Dependent empty elimination: #0. For a constant motive, the explosion principle is the derived operation #1. Both eliminate into any Sort u.

zh-CN.body: 依赖的空消去：#0。取常值动机时，爆炸原理就是导出的运算 #1。两者均可消去到任意 Sort u。
